partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Two-driver physical connector inhibition
results.hypothesis: A drug can control a disease module by inhibiting a non-causal connector protein that directly interacts with at least two top-ranked causal disease genes.
results.body: drug binds and decreases connector; connector directly interacts with at least two distinct top-three causal disease genes
results.mechanism_rationale: The nonlinear star motif targets a shared physical control point outside the disease causal-gene set, but the mechanism is vulnerable to interaction hubs.
results.trapi_notes: The binding, effect, interaction, and causal-gene paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-driver cardinality, rank, identity, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, target, object, collect(DISTINCT driver) AS drivers
WHERE size(drivers) >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Two-driver physical connector activation control
results.hypothesis: Increasing the same physical connector provides a directional control for R285.
results.body: R285 structure with increased connector activity or abundance
results.mechanism_rationale: Without disease-module direction, activation is a control rather than a predicted correction.

results.name: Compact two-driver physical connector inhibition
results.hypothesis: The two-driver connector mechanism is more specific when the connector has no more than the graph p90 of ten direct gene interaction partners.
results.body: R285 plus connector direct-gene interaction degree at most 10
results.mechanism_rationale: The degree constraint removes promiscuous interaction hubs while retaining a nonlinear physical module.
results.trapi_notes: Same path expressibility as R285; connector-degree and cardinality constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND COUNT {
    (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(:Gene)
  } <= 10

  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
WITH subject, target, object, collect(DISTINCT driver) AS drivers

RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
